review:
An early Pragmatic Megaways with a full-moon horror theme. The official description is brief – two features, and it's described as highly volatile.

The in-game screens advertise up to 40,000x, one of the highest caps among Pragmatic's games, which fits that description. With the ever-changing Megaways reels, expect long quiet stretches and occasional big spikes. 96.5% RTP. The demo is the best way to figure it out.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
